info.name: QuickTasker API
info.description: Generated by tests/api/build-collection.js — do not edit by hand. Run with `npm run test:api`.

item.name: 00 Setup
item.description: Creates two boards, stages, a task on board B and API tokens. IDs are stored as collection variables.

item.name: Create full-access token for board A

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Full {{runId}}",
  "get_pipeline": true,
  "patch_pipeline": true,
  "get_pipeline_stages": true,
  "post_pipeline_stages": true,
  "patch_pipeline_stages": true,
  "delete_pipeline_stages": true,
  "get_pipeline_tasks": true,
  "post_pipeline_tasks": true,
  "patch_pipeline_tasks": true,
  "delete_pipeline_tasks": true
}

item.name: 01 Token API
item.description: Bearer-token API under /token/board. Every token is scoped to one board and a set of permission flags.

item.name: Token without Bearer prefix is accepted
Token without get_pipeline permission is forbidden
Token is scoped to its own board

exec: pm.test('name updated', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.board.name).to.eql('API Board A ' + pm.collectionVariables.get('runId') + ' renamed'));

item.name: Update stage description only keeps name
Update stage requires at least one field
Cannot update a stage on another board
Cannot delete a stage on another board
Cannot create a task in a stage on another board
Cannot update a task on another board
Cannot move task to a stage on another board

exec: pm.test('message mentions "Stage not found"', () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json())).to.include('Stage not found'));

item.name: Enable "only last stage can be done" setting
Cannot mark done outside last stage when restricted
Disable "only last stage can be done" setting
Cannot mark done a task on another board
Cannot delete stage that has tasks
Cannot delete a task on another board
02 Public API
item.description: Unauthenticated public task submission form API. Uses board A.

item.name: Submitting to a disabled board fails
Status lookup returns the submitted task
Status lookup does not expose non-public tasks
Require logged-in users and reset count
Status shows login required for anonymous visitor
Anonymous submission fails when login is required
Logged-in submission succeeds when login is required
Token of a deleted board is rejected
